newsitem.title: USA: PIMCO Commercial Mortgage sets payout.
newsitem.headline: PIMCO Commercial Mortgage sets payout.

text.p: PIMCO Commercial Mortgage Securities Trust Inc, a closed-end investment company investing primarily in commercial mortgage-backed securities, on Friday declared a monthly dividend of $09.375 per share of ordinary income.

The fund also declared an additional $0.05 a share special dividend. The special dividend will be paid entirely from ordinary income that has accumulated over the past six months in excess of the fund's regular monthly distributions.

A similar special dividend was paid in July. The two distributions will be paid together in an aggregate amount of $0.14375 per share on Jan. 9, 1997, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on Dec. 31, 1996.
The dividends will be paid in cash.
